strategy: Region evidence report on the preserved pyEpi baseline: raw-count contrast with exposure, percentile against same-width random windows, coverage invariance, dosage-compatibility class, per-cell mixture bound, QC-gap adjacency, allelic observability and empirically calibrated allelic label; multi-state output including 'insufficient evidence'
stage_changed: evidence integration (after segmentation and CN assignment; calls unchanged)
what_it_resolves: Separates 'depth changed' from 'dosage explains it'; makes missing allele evidence and QC removal explicit; flags calls whose depth contrast is outside what a one-copy change of the baseline can produce
published_evidence: Indirect: epiAneufinder uses read depth as a CN proxy (Ramakrishnan 2023); Numbat-multiome shows that allele evidence adds CNLoH and specificity (2025). No published scATAC tool emits this evidence layer
local_evidence_this_review: Exp 04: chr7 saved windows 0.13-0.34x raw, below the one-copy floor, coverage-invariant, <=2.3% of cells could carry a near-complete loss; 19/226 uncalled random windows also below 0.5x. Exp 06: retained balanced sites in chr7 windows; 9p21 shows the expected het-site depletion; MYC/5q are positive allelic controls
prerequisites: Retained raw counts, X, HA/HB/AT, cluster labels, breakpoints (all present)
limitations: Descriptive; random windows are not neutral truth; thresholds are development choices; allelic power is attenuated and needs SNP-level calibration; does not decide CN by itself
version_license: New research code in this repo (MIT); uses pinned pyEpi functions unmodified
reason_for_rank: Highest information per unit effort; transfers to any sample with or without a normal reference; resolves the user's stated problem (unsupported short losses, insufficient evidence) without changing a formula

strategy: Keep the pre-filter bin grid and represent QC-removed bins as an explicit 'unobservable: too few nonzero cells' state (and keep cell-filter masks)
stage_changed: upstream QC bookkeeping (no change to retained values)
what_it_resolves: Prevents clonal homozygous deletions and other all-cell depletions from silently becoming gaps; enables relaxed-QC sensitivity analyses
published_evidence: epiAneufinder states that the >85%-zero bin filter targets low-mappability regions (Ramakrishnan 2023)
local_evidence_this_review: Exp 02: CDKN2A/B bins (published MCF10-A homozygous deletion) were removed by the bin filter; 818 non-gap autosomal bins removed in 193 runs
prerequisites: Pre-QC counts or the fragment file; run parameters
limitations: Needs a mappability/accessibility prior to interpret removed runs; cannot be retrofitted to this package
cost: Low in pipeline code; requires rerun from fragments
version_license: Pipeline change to pyEpi (BSD-3-clause per pyproject; repo license to verify)
reason_for_rank: General failure mode, cheap to fix, high consequence for focal deletion recall; blocked here only by inputs

strategy: Cross-sample / technical baseline: same binning applied to >=2 unrelated scATAC samples (ideally with scDNA/WGS) plus a mappability track matched to the alignment reference, used as an offset or a soft flag
stage_changed: CN assignment reference and evidence integration
what_it_resolves: Tests whether deep, homogeneous, coverage-invariant dips recur across unrelated samples (accessibility/mappability baseline) or are sample-specific (candidate dosage)
published_evidence: Numbat-multiome and inferCNV-style tools rely on normal references; ENCODE blacklist and Umap motivate mappability priors (see sources); atlas references are not verified copy-neutral
local_evidence_this_review: Exp 04/07: depth varies 0.44-1.72x between neighbouring uncalled 2.5 Mb windows; chr7 67.4-70.0 is an even ~0.13x plateau, typical of a systematic baseline or dosage, not patchy accessibility
prerequisites: Other samples' fragments processed identically; mappability track and alignment reference provenance
limitations: A baseline from other samples carries their own CN and cell-state differences; must not be forced from MCF10-A identity
version_license: Depends on sources (Umap code GPL-3.0; data terms vary)
reason_for_rank: The decisive experiment for the saved chr7 windows; needed before any formula change can be judged

strategy: Raw-count, exposure-aware, gap-aware segmentation and CN assignment (NB/Poisson with per-cell exposure and optional baseline offset; explicit missingness; estimand documented)
what_it_resolves: Removes rounding/clipping/GC-amplification artefacts and equal-cell weighting from the measurement; gives a likelihood that can report uncertainty; allows a reference level other than the genome median
published_evidence: Count-based changepoint and HMM methods (B review: FACETS/ASCAT transfers, Numbat HMM); not validated for scATAC focal events
local_evidence_this_review: Exp 03: raw estimands change 20-37% of bin calls on identical boundaries; all scale fits sit at the grid edge, so current calls are thresholds on mean/genome median; exp 05: pseudobulk significance reflects reproducible structure, not sampling
prerequisites: Raw counts (present), exposure (present), GC/mappability covariates, a reference/baseline (rank 3)
limitations: GC confounding moves from preprocessing into the model and is still unidentified without a baseline; calibration needs benchmarks
reason_for_rank: Addresses measurable estimand problems but its benefit cannot be shown on MCF10-A alone; follow ranks 1 and 3

strategy: Joint depth + allele model with empirically calibrated allelic likelihood (phase-block aware, SNP-level, molecule-aware)
what_it_resolves: Uses allelic imbalance to support or weaken a depth call and to find CNLoH; tolerates missing alleles
published_evidence: Numbat-multiome reports improved CNLoH detection by combining coverage and alleles (2025); Alleloscope pools SNPs over DNA-defined regions (2021)
local_evidence_this_review: Exp 06: nominal AT overstates power (MYC effective abs dBAF 0.11); 31% of uncalled random windows exceed the balanced model; observed sites in chr7 windows are balanced
prerequisites: SNP-level allele counts, phase sets, unique-molecule counting
limitations: Ascertainment: clonal LOH removes het sites when there is no matched normal; bin-level HA/HB cannot be calibrated
reason_for_rank: Valuable, but blocked until SNP-level data exist; independent per-bin likelihoods would currently be miscalibrated

what_it_resolves: Published joint coverage/allele HMM with clone inference, as a benchmark comparator
published_evidence: Numbat-multiome (Brief Bioinform 2025, 26(5):bbaf516): scATAC-only and combined modes; median F1 > 0.9 against WGS in MM and CLL/RS cohorts; arm/focal evaluation excludes events < 200 kb or < 10% of an arm (prior review)
local_evidence_this_review: Not executed. Repo b444f3c (v1.5.2, MIT) ATAC-bin needs fragments binned by get_binned_atac.R, allele counts from pileup_and_phase.R, and a binned ATAC reference from normal samples
prerequisites: Fragments, SNP-level phased allele counts, normal ATAC reference
limitations: Requires a reference; joint 10x multiome not fully supported per vignette; small focal events not specifically validated
reason_for_rank: Best published comparator, but its prerequisites are missing and it presumes a normal reference; cannot outperform anything until run

strategy: Alleloscope regional allele-specific CN (scATAC + matched bulk DNA)
what_it_resolves: Allele-specific states for regions defined independently (ideally from DNA)
published_evidence: Wu et al. Nat Biotechnol 2021: scATAC with sample-matched bulk DNA; no external phasing required
limitations: Using our own depth boundaries would be circular; GPL-2
reason_for_rank: Useful for validating specific regions once DNA segments exist; not a general first step

strategy: GC-step hardening (guard small/negative LOESS predictions, cap the correction, record fit failures, keep float intermediates)
what_it_resolves: Removes isolated amplified bins (up to 717x) and boundary zeroing; makes reconstruction exact
published_evidence: epiAneufinder methods describe the LOESS correction (2023)
local_evidence_this_review: Exp 01: 861 cell-bins amplified >30x, 12 bins where they make up >25% of the mean; 17 historical-only zeros unexplained
limitations: Small effect on the saved windows; GC confounding with biology remains; dataset-specific tuning is not the goal
reason_for_rank: Worth doing as hygiene with a documented scientific-change note; deprioritized at the user's request and because it does not explain the target dips

strategy: Recalibrate AD segmentation p-values (max-over-cut permutation, spatial or block nulls)
local_evidence_this_review: Exp 05: on exchangeable nulls only 1/300 first splits accepted at alpha 0.001; split halves r > 0.99; all saved window edges reproduce in both halves
limitations: Calibration to sampling noise does not address non-CN structure, which is the actual issue
reason_for_rank: Not the bottleneck: boundaries are reproducible; their interpretation is
